name: Gray failure: outlier detection
description: The same design as "Gray failure", with outlier detection turned on in the load balancer: after 5 failed requests in a row from one instance, it sends nothing to that instance for 30 seconds (at most half of the instances are ejected at the same time). The slow instance is ejected almost at once, tried again after 30 seconds, and ejected again. The liveness check still thinks it is healthy, so the health check removes nothing.
